# OreMatch [italic]Strike it rich in love.[/italic]
Lonely on the night shift? Tired of the same forty faces in the canteen? OreMatch is the frontier's first video dating service, made for miners, drillers, haulers, refinery hands and anyone else who has not seen a new face since their last contract.
## HOW IT WORKS - [bold]Record.[/bold] Sit in front of a camcorder. Say your name, your colony and one nice thing about yourself. Do not wear your hard hat. Everybody wears their hard hat. - [bold]Post.[/bold] Mail the tape to OreMatch. We copy it onto the relay with thousands of other hopeful hearts. - [bold]Match.[/bold] When two colonists like each other's tapes, we send them each other's mail address. The rest is up to you, the relay and the shipping schedule.
## THIS WEEK'S SUCCESS [italic]We met on OreMatch in 2181. I was on a refinery, she was on an ice moon four systems away. We wrote every week. We finally met at Gateway in 2184. She was exactly like her tape, except taller. We are getting married as soon as one of our contracts ends.[/italic] Abe and Ingrid
